format: C# ASP.NET Web Forms (Code-behind for .aspx page)
description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page that displays and manages student answers for a specific course and student. It retrieves answers from a database and allows submitting marks, then updates relevant database records and navigates between pages.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Partial class for the ShowAns ASP.NET page, handling page load and button events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves student answers for multiple questions from the database and displays them.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler to navigate to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler to navigate to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler to navigate to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Event handler to submit marks, update the database with marks, remove the student from queue, and navigate to the Course Queue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler to log out and navigate to the login page.
